warrior.name: Berserker
warrior.blurb: Reckless fury. Hits harder the more hurt you are.

forms.name: Warlord
forms.blurb: A battlefield commander who breaks the earth.

forms.name: Bloodreaver
forms.blurb: Feeds on every wound it opens.

warrior.name: Guardian
warrior.blurb: Sword and shield. Holds the line where others fall.

forms.name: Juggernaut
forms.blurb: Unbreakable. Punishes anyone who strikes it.

forms.name: Sentinel
forms.blurb: A living wall that shields and stuns.

mage.name: Pyromancer
mage.blurb: Master of flame. Everything burns longer and hotter.

forms.name: Inferno Lord
forms.blurb: Brings the sky down in fire.

forms.name: Phoenix
forms.blurb: Burns, falls, and rises again from its own ashes.

mage.name: Frostbinder
mage.blurb: Control through ice. Frozen enemies shatter.

forms.name: Frost Sovereign
forms.blurb: Rules a kingdom of ice.

forms.name: Stormcaller
forms.blurb: Frost becomes storm and lightning.

forms.name: Saint
forms.blurb: Where they stand, allies cannot fall.

forms.name: Templar
forms.blurb: A holy warrior who smites the wicked.

priest.name: Shadow Priest
priest.blurb: Trades light for shadow. Drains life from enemies.

forms.name: Voidcaller
forms.blurb: Opens doors to the abyss.

forms.name: Soul Reaper
forms.blurb: Every death makes it stronger.

rogue.name: Assassin
rogue.blurb: The melee path. Close in, stun them senseless, and let critical hits do the rest.

forms.name: Nightblade
forms.blurb: Marks a victim for death. Nothing survives the mark.

forms.name: Deathstalker
forms.blurb: A whirl of blades that drinks every wound.

rogue.name: Shadowshot
rogue.blurb: The ranged path. Poisoned knives from afar: fear, damage over time and creeping venom.

forms.name: Nightmare
forms.blurb: Every shadow becomes a terror. Enemies flee screaming while the poison works.

forms.name: Plaguebringer
forms.blurb: Every blade drips with plague.

forms.name: Sniper
forms.blurb: One shot. One kill.

forms.name: Windrunner
forms.blurb: Arrows fall like rain on the wind.

ranger.name: Beastmaster
ranger.blurb: Hunts beside spirit wolves and the wild.

forms.name: Wildheart
forms.blurb: The herd answers your call and tramples everything.

forms.name: Packlord
forms.blurb: Leads a pack of spirit wolves that heal you as they bite.

druid.name: Wildshape
druid.blurb: Becomes the beast: claw, maul and endure.

forms.name: Great Bear
forms.blurb: An unmovable wall of fur and fury.

forms.name: Stormclaw
forms.blurb: A great cat, fast and bloodthirsty.

druid.name: Grovekeeper
druid.blurb: Speaks for the forest. Heals, and calls down the stars.

forms.name: Ancient
forms.blurb: An old tree-spirit that shelters and binds.

forms.name: Tempest
forms.blurb: Wind and lightning at your call.

shaman.name: Earthcaller
shaman.blurb: The healer's path. Totems of life root the whole party.

forms.name: Spiritwalker
forms.blurb: Walks with the ancestors; their hands mend every wound.

forms.name: Elder of the Grove
forms.blurb: An old shaman whose totems never fall.

shaman.name: Stormcaller
shaman.blurb: The storm's path. Lightning, fire totems and the war-drum.

forms.name: Thunderlord
forms.blurb: The sky answers your call.

forms.name: Flamebinder
forms.blurb: Fire spirits bound into every totem.

rampage.name: Rampage
rampage.desc: 8s frenzy: +40% damage, 40% faster attacks, and your hits heal you.

shieldwall.name: Shield Wall
shieldwall.desc: 6s: take 50% less damage and gain a shield.

earthsplit.name: Earthsplitter
earthsplit.desc: Split the ground ahead: 3.5× damage in a long line, stuns for 2s.

harvest.name: Crimson Harvest
harvest.desc: Carve everything around you for 3× damage and heal for half of it.

unstoppable.name: Unstoppable
unstoppable.desc: 8s: take 60% less damage and reflect 30% back at attackers.

aegis.name: Aegis Slam
aegis.desc: Slam your shield down: 2.5× damage around you, 2.5s stun, and a 60 HP shield.

flamewave.name: Flame Wave
flamewave.desc: A cone of fire in front of you: 1.8× damage and burns.

blizzard.name: Blizzard
blizzard.desc: An ice storm on your target for 5s: damage every second and slows.

firestorm.name: Firestorm
firestorm.desc: Rain fire on the target area for 6 seconds.

zero.name: Absolute Zero
zero.desc: Freeze everything near you solid for 3s: 2.5× damage.

chain.name: Chain Lightning
chain.desc: 3× damage that jumps to four more enemies.

radiance.name: Radiance
radiance.desc: Heal 20% HP and burn nearby enemies for 1.5× damage.

voidbolt.name: Void Bolt
voidbolt.desc: A bolt of shadow: 2.2× damage, then decay over time.

sanctuary.name: Sanctuary
sanctuary.desc: Holy ground for 8s: heals 5% HP a second and burns enemies inside.

judgment.name: Judgment
judgment.desc: A pillar of light strikes your target: 4× damage and 2s stun.

rift.name: Void Rift
rift.desc: Tear open a rift for 6s: damage every second and slows.

soulharvest.name: Soul Harvest
soulharvest.desc: 2× damage to everything near you, and heal 10% HP per enemy hit.

ambush.name: Ambush
ambush.desc: 3× damage to the enemy in front of you. After Vanish or Shadowstep it is a guaranteed critical.

smokebomb.name: Smoke Bomb
smokebomb.desc: A cloud of smoke for 6s: you evade 75% of attacks and enemies inside are slowed.

deathmark.name: Death Mark
deathmark.desc: Mark a target: it takes 40% more damage, and after 5 seconds the mark bursts for 5×.

thousandcuts.name: Thousand Cuts
thousandcuts.desc: 12 lightning-fast slashes on enemies around you, 0.9× each. Each one heals you.

phantomblades.name: Phantom Blades
phantomblades.desc: Three shadow copies of you strike 12 times across nearby enemies, 1.2× each.

plague.name: Plague Cloud
plague.desc: A plague cloud on the target area for 6s: damage every second and deep poison.

piercing.name: Piercing Shot
piercing.desc: An arrow that goes through every enemy in a long line, 2.2× damage.

wolfcall.name: Call of the Wild
wolfcall.desc: Spirit wolves pounce on nearby enemies 6 times, 1.3× each.

headshot.name: Headshot
headshot.desc: Take a breath and aim: 7× damage to one target.

arrowstorm.name: Arrow Storm
arrowstorm.desc: Arrows rain on the target area for 6 seconds.

stampede.name: Stampede
stampede.desc: Spirit beasts thunder forward: 3.5× damage in a long line and a 2s stun.

packhunt.name: Pack Hunt
packhunt.desc: A spirit pack bites 10 times across enemies near you, 1.4× each. Every bite heals you.

maul.name: Maul
maul.desc: Leap in with bear claws: 2.4× damage and a short stun.

starfire.name: Starfire
starfire.desc: A falling star: 2.8× damage and splashes enemies around the target.

bearroar.name: Ursine Roar
bearroar.desc: 8s: take 60% less damage and reflect 30%. Enemies near you take 2× and are stunned.

feralfury.name: Feral Fury
feralfury.desc: 8s of fury: +40% damage, faster attacks, hits heal you. Claws rake everything near you.

wildgrowth.name: Wild Growth
wildgrowth.desc: Heal 40% HP, gain a shield worth 20%, and roots grab every enemy near you for 3s.

hurricane.name: Hurricane
hurricane.desc: A storm on the target area for 6s: wind and lightning hit everything inside every second.

terror.name: Terror Knife
terror.desc: A cursed knife: 1.4× damage and the target flees in terror for 3 seconds.

nightmare.name: Nightmare
nightmare.desc: Unleash a nightmare: 2.2× damage to everything near you, and all of them flee for 4 seconds.

spirittotem.name: Spirit Totem
spirittotem.desc: A totem of ancestor spirits for 14 seconds: heals you and your party 8% of max HP every second.

chainlight.name: Chain Lightning
chainlight.desc: Lightning leaps between up to three enemies, 1.6× each.

ancestors.name: Call of the Ancestors
ancestors.desc: The ancestors answer: heal yourself and your party for 60% of max HP.

greattotem.name: Great Totem
greattotem.desc: Raise a great totem for 25 seconds that heals everyone near 10% of max HP every second.

thunderstorm.name: Thunderstorm
thunderstorm.desc: Call down a storm on the target: 3.2× damage around it and everything is stunned for 2 seconds.

magmatotem.name: Magma Totem
magmatotem.desc: A totem of living magma for 18 seconds that hurls fire at the two nearest enemies every second (1.8× each).

phoenixburst.name: Phoenix Burst
phoenixburst.desc: Burst into phoenix fire: 3× damage to everything near you and sets it burning for 5s.

warrior.name: Shield Bash
warrior.desc: 1.6× damage and a 2s stun on the enemy in front of you.

warrior.name: Rend
warrior.desc: Slash open the enemy in front: 1.2× damage and it bleeds for 6 seconds.

warrior.name: Leap Slam
warrior.desc: Leap onto an enemy up to 380 away: 1.8× damage around the landing and a short stun.

warrior.name: Iron Will
warrior.desc: A shield worth 25% of your HP for 8 seconds, and heal 10%.

warrior.name: Ground Slam
warrior.desc: Smash the ground: 1.8× damage to everything close and slows them.

warrior.name: Execute
warrior.desc: A finishing blow: 4.5× damage to an enemy below 30% HP, otherwise 1.5×.

warrior.name: Blade Storm
warrior.desc: Spin through the fight for 3 seconds, hitting everything around you 8 times.

warrior.name: Second Wind
warrior.desc: Catch your breath: heal 35% HP instantly.

warrior.name: Titan Strike
warrior.desc: A world-shaking blow: 5× damage to one enemy.

warrior.name: Avatar of War
warrior.desc: 10 seconds as an avatar of war: rampage fury and a shield worth 30% of your HP.

mage.name: Arcane Missiles
mage.desc: Three arcane bolts in quick succession, 0.9× damage each.

mage.name: Ice Lance
mage.desc: A spear of ice: 2.6× damage and slows the target.

mage.name: Flame Pillar
mage.desc: A column of fire on your target for 4 seconds that burns anything inside.

mage.name: Chain Spark
mage.desc: 1.6× damage that arcs to three more enemies.

mage.name: Time Warp
mage.desc: Bend time: every other spell’s cooldown drops by 8 seconds.

mage.name: Comet
mage.desc: Call a comet: after a moment it crashes down for 4× damage in a wide area.

mage.name: Frost Prison
mage.desc: Encase an enemy in ice: 1.5× damage and frozen solid for 4 seconds.

mage.name: Arcane Explosion
mage.desc: Detonate raw magic: 2.2× damage to everything near you.

mage.name: Living Bomb
mage.desc: Plant a flame in an enemy. 3 seconds later it explodes for 3.5× damage around it.

mage.name: Cataclysm
mage.desc: Tear the sky open: eight meteors rain around your target over 3 seconds.

priest.name: Smite
priest.desc: A quick holy bolt: 1.7× damage, and you heal for 20% of it.

priest.name: Purify
priest.desc: Heal 18% HP now and a little more over 4 seconds.

priest.name: Holy Nova
priest.desc: A burst of light: 1.5× damage around you and heal 12% HP.

priest.name: Chains of Light
priest.desc: Bind an enemy in light: 1.2× damage and held for 3 seconds.

priest.name: Guardian Spirit
priest.desc: A spirit shields you for 30% of your HP for 10 seconds.

priest.name: Penance
priest.desc: Three rays of light strike your target, 1.3× damage each.

priest.name: Sacred Ground
priest.desc: Bless the ground for 8 seconds: heals you 4% HP a second and burns enemies inside.

priest.name: Wrath of Heaven
priest.desc: Heaven strikes your target’s area: 3× damage and a 1s stun.

priest.name: Prayer of Life
priest.desc: A long prayer that restores 60% of your HP.

priest.name: Divine Storm
priest.desc: Six pillars of light fall around you over 2 seconds, 2.5× damage each.

rogue.name: Gouge
rogue.desc: 1.0× damage and the enemy is stunned for 2.5 seconds.

rogue.name: Garrote
rogue.desc: 1.4× damage and the enemy bleeds for 8 seconds.

rogue.name: Evasion
rogue.desc: For 8 seconds you evade 60% of attacks.

rogue.name: Eviscerate
rogue.desc: A brutal finisher: 3.6× damage to one enemy.

rogue.name: Blade Dance
rogue.desc: Dance through the fight for 2 seconds, slashing everything around you 6 times.

rogue.name: Cloak of Shadows
rogue.desc: Wrap yourself in shadow: immune to damage for 3 seconds.

rogue.name: Assassinate
rogue.desc: Finish a weakened enemy: 6× damage if it is below 30% HP, otherwise 2×.

rogue.name: Shadow Dance
rogue.desc: 8 seconds where every hit you land is a critical.

ranger.name: Concussive Shot
ranger.desc: 1.3× damage and the target is slowed for 4 seconds.

ranger.name: Explosive Arrow
ranger.desc: The arrow explodes: 1.7× damage around the target and sets it ablaze.

ranger.name: Rapid Fire
ranger.desc: Loose six arrows at your target in quick succession, 0.8× each.

ranger.name: Camouflage
ranger.desc: Blend into the land: enemies lose you and you evade half of all attacks for 6 seconds.

ranger.name: Volley
ranger.desc: A volley on the target area for 3 seconds.

ranger.name: Barbed Arrow
ranger.desc: 1.8× damage and the target bleeds for 8 seconds.

ranger.name: Frost Trap
ranger.desc: Freeze everything close to you for 3 seconds: 1.2× damage.

ranger.name: Eagle Eye
ranger.desc: 10 seconds of +30% damage and faster shots.

ranger.name: Kill Shot
ranger.desc: Finish it: 5.5× damage to a target below 30% HP, otherwise 1.8×.

ranger.name: Rain of Arrows
ranger.desc: Arrows blot out the sky over a wide area for 6 seconds.

druid.name: Thorns
druid.desc: Thorny bark for 10 seconds: attackers take 35% of their damage back.

druid.name: Insect Swarm
druid.desc: 1.2× damage and a swarm eats at the target for 10 seconds.

druid.name: Cyclone
druid.desc: Lift an enemy in a whirlwind: helpless for 4 seconds.

druid.name: Barkskin
druid.desc: Skin like bark for 8 seconds: take 50% less damage.

druid.name: Starfall
druid.desc: Six stars fall around your target, 1.8× damage each.

druid.name: Nature’s Grasp
druid.desc: Roots burst from the ground: 1.4× damage to everything near you and rooted for 3 seconds.

druid.name: Tranquility
druid.desc: A peaceful glade for 6 seconds: heals you 7% HP every second while you stand in it.

druid.name: Force of Nature
druid.desc: Treant spirits rise and strike 8 times across nearby enemies, 1.6× each.

druid.name: Wrath of the Wild
druid.desc: The wild itself answers: 3.5× damage to everything near you, roots for 2s, and heal 20% HP.

shaman.name: Frost Shock
shaman.desc: 1.3× damage and the target is slowed for 4 seconds.

shaman.name: Searing Totem
shaman.desc: A fire totem for 12 seconds that throws flame at the two nearest enemies every second (0.6× each).

shaman.name: Healing Wave
shaman.desc: Heal yourself and your party for 30% of max HP.

shaman.name: Windfury Totem
shaman.desc: For 14 seconds everyone near the totem deals 35% more damage.

shaman.name: Ghost Wolf
shaman.desc: Turn half spirit for 4 seconds: slip away from every attack.

shaman.name: Lava Burst
shaman.desc: A bolt of lava: 3× damage and the target burns for 4 seconds.

shaman.name: Earthquake
shaman.desc: The ground heaves around you: 1.6× damage to everything near, and they are stunned for 1.5 seconds.

shaman.name: Riptide
shaman.desc: A tide of healing water: restore 40% of your HP over 8 seconds.

shaman.name: Storm Totem
shaman.desc: A crackling totem for 15 seconds that strikes the two nearest enemies with lightning every second (1.1× each).

shaman.name: Bloodlust
shaman.desc: The war-drums beat: 12 seconds of 40% more damage.

DESC.cleave: Sweep in front of you: 1.35× damage to every enemy in the arc.
DESC.blow: A heavy overhead strike: 2.4× damage to one enemy.
DESC.charge: Rush to an enemy, hit it and stun it for 1.6s.
DESC.whirl: Spin three times, hitting everything around you.
DESC.fireball: Hurl fire at your target: 2.2× damage and burns.
DESC.nova: Freeze nearby enemies in place for 2.4s.
DESC.blink: Teleport a short way in the direction you move.
DESC.meteor: Call down a meteor on your target: 3.2× area damage.
DESC.barrier: A shield that absorbs damage for 10s.
DESC.consecrate: Holy ground for 6s: hurts enemies and heals you.
DESC.backstab: 2.1× damage. 2.8× from behind or if the enemy is stunned.
DESC.shadowstep: Step behind an enemy, strike it, and your next hit is a critical.
DESC.fanknives: Knives in every direction: 1.25× damage and slows everything near you.
DESC.vanish: Disappear: enemies lose track of you and your next hit is a critical.
DESC.aimed: A careful shot: 2.1× damage from long range.
DESC.multishot: Arrows at your target and up to four enemies near it, 0.95× each.
DESC.disengage: Leap away from danger, slowing enemies close to you.
DESC.snare: A trap at your feet. The first enemies to step in are snared for 3 seconds.
DESC.huntmark: Mark a target: it takes 40% more damage from you for 12 seconds.
DESC.roots: Roots bind an enemy in place for 3 seconds.
DESC.rejuv: Heal a little now and a lot over 10 seconds.
DESC.moonfire: Moonlight strikes your target: 1.5× damage and it burns for 6 seconds.
DESC.bearform: Become a bear for 10s: take 40% less damage and gain a shield.
DESC.healtotem: Plant a healing totem for 12 seconds: you and your party near it heal 5% of max HP every second.
DESC.wartotem: Plant a war totem for 12 seconds: everyone near it deals 25% more damage.
DESC.chainheal: Heal yourself 20% of max HP, and every sellsword near you just as much.
DESC.earthshock: Shake the ground under an enemy: 1.4× damage and slowed for 3 seconds.
